components.name: Resistor
components.function: Limits the flow of electrical current in a circuit.

components.name: Capacitor
components.function: Stores and releases electrical energy in an electric field.

components.name: Inductor
components.function: Stores energy in a magnetic field when electric current flows through it.

components.name: Diode
components.function: Allows current to flow in one direction only.

components.name: Transistor
components.function: Amplifies or switches electrical signals and power.

components.name: LED
components.function: Emits light when electric current passes through it.

components.name: Potentiometer
components.function: A three-terminal resistor with a sliding contact that acts as an adjustable voltage divider.

components.name: Microcontroller
components.function: A small computer on a single integrated circuit containing a processor, memory, and input/output peripherals.

components.name: Push Button
components.function: A simple switch mechanism to control some aspect of a machine or a process.

components.name: Buzzer
components.function: An audio signaling device that converts an electrical signal to sound.

components.name: Crystal Oscillator
components.function: Creates an electrical signal with a precise frequency using the mechanical resonance of a vibrating crystal.

components.name: Relay
components.function: An electrically operated switch that uses an electromagnet to mechanically operate a switch.

components.name: Photoresistor
components.function: A light-controlled variable resistor whose resistance decreases with increasing incident light intensity.

components.name: Voltage Regulator
components.function: Designed to automatically maintain a constant voltage level.

components.name: Thermistor
components.function: A type of resistor whose resistance is significantly dependent on temperature.
